permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Hears what you say through the glasses, so you can talk to Jarvis with your hands busy. Audio is transcribed on your own server and never uploaded anywhere else.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Used instead of the glasses microphone when the glasses are not available, so the app still works on the phone alone.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to your own Jarvis server, which is the only thing this app talks to. The address is yours and is set by you.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Reads the QR code your server prints, so you do not have to type a web address and a long token on a phone. The camera is opened only while you are scanning.
